name: Cursola
description: Cursola, the Coral Pokémon, and the evolved form of Corsola. A Ghost type.
pokedex_entries: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.
Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
